WTC_7_observation: No publicly established demolition preparation; known long fires and debris damage
explosive_implosion: Extensive survey; nonloadbearing removal; column weakening; charge and delay placement
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Strategic cuts/weakening; hydraulic jacks or cable pull
mechanical_dismantling: Long visible top-down or sectional work
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: No demolition preparation; fire damage accumulates
source_notes: Preparation evidence is cause-specific but absence is harder to prove than presence

WTC_7_observation: Interior/roof and window/dust changes precede north-façade descent; lower floors poorly visible
explosive_implosion: Often charge flashes/debris puffs at selected lower or transfer floors; geometry is designed
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Movement starts at weakened/jacked/pulled zone; hinge or collision may be visible
mechanical_dismantling: Local bites/cuts and removal; no sudden whole-building onset in ordinary operation
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Local sagging buckling or partial collapse may precede terminal progression

WTC_7_observation: North façade descends coherently for an interval; east edge rotates north; later breakup
explosive_implosion: Coherent descent folding or directional fall can be designed
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Upper block may translate rotate or descend coherently before impact
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Can be coherent after interior support loss but often shows pronounced staged/asymmetric distress
source_notes: Morphology is shared by several support-removal mechanisms

WTC_7_observation: NIST measured about 2.25 s at g over about 32 m for one north-roofline point
explosive_implosion: Possible after supports on the measured path are removed
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Possible before upper block impacts lower structure
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Physically possible if widespread support is already lost
source_notes: Free fall constrains net vertical resistance; it does not identify what removed capacity

WTC_7_observation: Not directly visible internally; NIST best-fit model progresses core failure east-to-west over about 2.6 s
explosive_implosion: Millisecond-scale charge delays can impose a designed sequence
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Seconds-scale fracture and collision sequence after trigger
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Can accelerate as load redistribution crosses capacity thresholds
source_notes: Do not describe the full event as simultaneous merely from façade motion

WTC_7_observation: NIST reviewed three distant obstructed soundtracks and reported no loud blast at onset; the 27 Angles compilation contains explosion testimony and transients but is heterogeneous and edit-prone
explosive_implosion: Conventional column-cutting charges ordinarily create distinct impulsive reports; the confirmed Hertz control has a rapid broadband impulse train
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: No blast required; fracture/impact sounds occur
source_notes: Negative audio evidence weighs against conventional explosives but recording geometry quality provenance synchronization and digital mastering limit certainty

WTC_7_observation: No unambiguous charge flashes established in the reviewed sources; dust appears before and during façade descent
explosive_implosion: May show flashes and sharp localized ejecta but wrapping dust and occlusion can hide them
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Dust and ejecta occur at fracture/collision zones without flashes
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Smoke/dust and pressure-driven window discharge can occur

WTC_7_observation: NIST estimated northeast roof corner 11 m ± 3 m north of original footprint after about seven stories of descent; later breakup
explosive_implosion: Direction and containment are engineered but substantial lateral motion and debris spread are common
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Upper block commonly tilts or translates
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Direction follows asymmetric damage and load path
source_notes: Contradicts literal 'perfectly into its own footprint' wording

WTC_7_observation: Large dust cloud obscures late sequence
explosive_implosion: Expected from floor impacts and pulverized finishes
mechanical_dismantling: Lower intensity and localized during ordinary work
source_notes: Dust is an impact product common to all rapid collapses

WTC_7_observation: Poor in most useful WTC 7 views because of foreground buildings smoke and dust
explosive_implosion: Often deliberately filmed with clear base view
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Often partly obscured by smoke emergency activity or adjacent structures
source_notes: The missing view limits claims about where and how support first vanished

WTC_7_observation: No publicly established charge residue cut-column pattern or recovered WTC 7 steel sample tied to the hypothesis
explosive_implosion: Charge residues wiring cut patterns and preparation records can identify method
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Cuts jack pockets cables and preparation records identify method
mechanical_dismantling: Tool marks and work records identify method
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Fire damage fracture and deformation evidence can discriminate mechanisms
source_notes: Video should be integrated with physical evidence not substituted for it

WTC_7_observation: Compatible with rapid widespread support loss; cause underdetermined
explosive_implosion: Some visual similarity especially verticality rapid onset and dust
nonexplosive_induced_collapse: Some visual similarity shows explosives are not necessary for implosion-like motion
mechanical_dismantling: Poor match to sudden global event
accidental_fire_progressive_collapse: Shows that long fire can culminate abruptly but case morphology varies
source_notes: Visual resemblance supplies hypotheses not a mechanism diagnosis
